method: Read-only fetch of official terms/metadata pages (no data downloaded). The 2026-09-29 saved PGI pages (coal/raw/pgi-data-rights.html, pgi-data-attribution.html, pgi-midas-source.html, pgi-reuse.html) are 212-839 byte Incapsula bot-block stubs and contain no terms.

sources.publisher: Panstwowy Instytut Geologiczny - Panstwowy Instytut Badawczy (PIG-PIB), MIDAS
sources.data_used: 343 coal deposit polygons (coal-polygons.geojson), 147 mineral deposit polygons (poland-minerals.geojson), 19 gypsum/anhydrite deposit polygons (gypsum-reviewed.geojson)

evidence.what: Polish national open-data portal (dane.gov.pl) record 'System Gospodarki i Ochrony Bogactw Mineralnych (MIDAS)', institution PIG-PIB, modified 2025-09-08; resources include the MIDAS deposit (zloza kopalin) and written-off deposit (zloza wybilansowane) shapefiles and the MIDAS WMS.
INSPIRE metadata of the MIDAS WFS download service (metadata date 2026-07-24).
evidence.quote: Brak warunkow dostepu i uzytkowania (no conditions apply to access and use)

sources.attribution: Zrodlo: Panstwowy Instytut Geologiczny - PIB, MIDAS (CC BY 4.0), retrieved 2026-09-29
sources.unresolved: The PGI web page https://www.pgi.gov.pl/rejestry-i-bazy-danych-geologicznych/zasady-korzystania-z-isp.html is still bot-blocked for automated reads; the national open-data portal licence above is used as the governing reuse statement.

sources.publisher: Saechsisches Landesamt fuer Umwelt, Landwirtschaft und Geologie (LfULG)
sources.data_used: 170 coal-seam polygons (RUEK400 fossile Brennstoffe, BRK400_UTM33.zip) and 119 lignite-field polygons (Braunkohlefelder_UTM33.zip), both downloaded from https://luis.sachsen.de/geologie/rohstoffgeologische-karten.html

evidence.what: LUIS page 'Nutzungsbedingungen fuer Geodaten und Geodatendienste des Saechsischen Landesamtes fuer Umwelt, Landwirtschaft und Geologie (LfULG)', which governs data offered on LUIS including the rohstoffgeologische Karten downloads. No page date.
Fees element of the lignite download service capabilities.
evidence.quote: gemaess den Nutzungsbestimmungen von Datenlizenz Deutschland - Namensnennung - Version 2.0

sources.attribution: Quelle: Saechsisches Landesamt fuer Umwelt, Landwirtschaft und Geologie, dl-de/by-2-0
sources.unresolved: The rohstoffgeologische-karten download page itself carries no licence text; the LfULG general geodata terms page is relied upon.

unchanged_exclusions: GEMDATA 2005 and DIADATA (research-only: reuse/location qualifications unresolved)
LGRB MIN4EU occurrence data (not used in runtime)
BGS licensed gypsum resource linework (only factual memoir localities are used)
Mindat and IAEA UDEPO are not used anywhere in this pipeline
